$comment: Golden conversation for the HelloCamera phone-client conformance kit. Meta-format: docs/conformance/README.md.
title: Corrupt current-job bytes trigger a scoped failure with fresh Retry/Dismiss

rejection.rule: Only currently correlated bytes that fail decode, media, dimension, or integrity validation produce a scoped failed visual job with fresh Retry/Dismiss; unrelated coaching remains valid. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §8.2)
rejection.effect: The phone renders a transient transfer error, sends protocol_error_v2 invalid_message related to the image messageId, and does not render the image. The desktop commits the visual job to failed and emits fresh Retry/Dismiss actions.

summary: An available artifact is announced, then the desktop sends bytes whose payload does not match the declared mimeType (not a PNG). The current-job bytes are corrupt; the failure is scoped to the visual job.

steps.note: Accepted sessionId and the visual bundle. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.2)

message.acceptedIntention: A confident full-body portrait at sunset

instruction.text: Photographer: move one step to your left.

visualGuidance.demonstrates: Move the subject one step left

artifact.demonstrates: Move the subject one step left
artifact.provenanceLabel: Edited illustration based on an earlier still — not the live preview.

steps.note: Available artifact announced; current reference is established. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §8.2)
Payload is not a PNG despite mimeType=image/png. Decode/media validation fails. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §8.2)

outcome: The phone does not render the image, retains unrelated coaching lanes, shows a transient transfer error, and sends protocol_error_v2 invalid_message related to the image messageId. The desktop commits the visual job to failed and emits fresh Retry/Dismiss.
